selection: count_threshold_pass == 1; no additional geographic or context filter
distance: Euclidean distance of square-root relative counts divided by sqrt(2)
prediction: unweighted mean of k nearest pollen analogues; stable sample-ID tie order
reference: mean of the same buffered training fold
notes: Choices fixed before inspecting experiment outputs; block sizes and buffer are design choices, not estimated optimal spatial scales.
Repeated rounded coordinate groups remain together; canonical longitude wraps +180 to -180.
Training samples within 100 km of any held-out sample are removed, including across the date line.
No location predictor enters the analogue distance; geography is used only for validation.
Modern validation does not establish palaeoclimate accuracy or age uncertainty.
